howToPlay: Use your bouncing energy balls to chip away at enemies grouped together. Place your turret in a strategic location to control the map and use your gadgets to support it. Heal your turret with Energize or boost its fire rate with Recoil Spring to maintain pressure.
gears: Use PET POWER to increase the turret's damage. DAMAGE and SHIELD are also great choices for general combat performance.
trait: This brawler suits players who enjoy tactical area control and maintaining a constant presence on the battlefield.
